title: Event envelope
description: EVENT_SCHEMAS.md §1. Every event on the bus is wrapped in this envelope and validated before publish. Maps 1:1 onto the `events` table (DATABASE_SCHEMA.md §13); `seq` and `stored_at` are assigned by the Event Store Consumer on write and are never set by producers, so they are not envelope fields. `payload` is validated separately against the per-event-type schema (EVENT_SCHEMAS.md §2-§7).

event_id.description: UUID, required — idempotency key, unique per event instance.

event_type.description: string, required — e.g. DEAL_SCORED. Not constrained to a fixed set here: EVENT_SCHEMAS.md §1 types this as a bare string, and the known-type check belongs to per-event-type payload validation.

version.description: integer, required — schema version of this event_type, starts at 1.

correlation_id.description: UUID, nullable — ties a causal chain together (e.g. all events for one order).

payload.description: object, required — shape defined per event_type in EVENT_SCHEMAS.md §2-§7.
